name: Spotlight Cards
description: Responsive grid of dark feature cards with a cursor-following spotlight glow that lights up card borders and surfaces across the whole grid on hover.
contents: Grid of cards, each with gradient icon, large faded background icon, title with arrow and description
behavior: A radial spotlight follows the cursor across every card, lighting borders and card surface
Hovered card lifts slightly and its arrow and background icon fade in
Grid collapses from 3 columns to 2 to 1 on smaller screens
editableByProps: Card icons, titles, descriptions and gradient accents
Page, card, border and spotlight colors
fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Icons use Font Awesome classes loaded from a CDN stylesheet link
